import http from 'k6/http';
import { sleep, check } from 'k6';

export let options = {
  // Define stages to ramp up traffic gradually
  stages: [
    { duration: '30s', target: 500 },   // Ramp up to 500 users in 30s
    { duration: '1m', target: 500 },    // Stay at 500 users for 1 minute
    { duration: '30s', target: 2000 },  // Spike to 2000 users
    { duration: '1m', target: 2000 },   // Hold peak load
    { duration: '30s', target: 0 },     // Ramp down to 0
  ],
  
  // Optional: Fail if error rate is too high (for monitoring)
  thresholds: {
    http_req_duration: ['p(95)<500'], // 95% of requests should be under 500ms
    http_req_failed: ['rate<0.5'],    // Less than 50% failure rate allowed
  },
};

export default function () {
  // Replace with your actual target URL
  let res = http.get('http://your-website.com');

  // Optional: Check if request succeeded (remove this for pure stress testing)
  check(res, {
    'status is 200': (r) => r.status === 200,
  });

  // Remove sleep() for maximum DoS impact, or keep it very low
  // sleep(0); // No pause = Maximum throughput
}
